steps.domain_action: The uninitialized even integer N is selected
The parity of N is confirmed as even
The interval [3, N/2] is projected as the search manifold
The manifold branches into candidate pairs
The first prime p is selected from the sieve
The complement N minus p is calculated
The complement is tested for primality
The complement is prime and the pair is validated
The complement is composite and the pair is rejected
The search returns to the next prime in the sieve
The results of the primality tests are aggregated
The error term is held in superposition for the density calculation
The candidate branches are reconstituted into the total density volume
The asymptotic density value is appended to the invariant record
The singular series constant seals the volume calculation
